notes.title: Quick update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
we have just released a small fix that solves most of the issues that prevented some people to play online and to unlock new achievements. Achievements are now back. Concerning the online connection issues, here's a little guide to what changes after the patch:

- If you have never created a Milestone account or you are starting the game for the first time, just launch the game and play normally.
- If you have created a Milestone account through the Network section of the launcher and you logged in before, just launch the game and play normally
- If you have created a Milestone account and disconnected from the network section of the laucher OR formatted/reinstalled the game, you must log in using your credentials through the network section of the launcher. If you don't do so, your online progression will start from zero (basically, if you don't log in with your older account the game will automatically create another account)
- If you have lost your credentials, you can contact our customer support at http://www.milestone.it/supporto

notes.title: Online and achievements issues
notes.notes:
Dear riders,
yesterday we have released a patch on Steam that moved our online infrastructure from our servers to the Steam servers, in order to guarantee a better and more stable experience for everyone. Unfortunately, we are now experiencing an issue that could prevent some users to play online.

Previously, the game required every user to create an account from the "Network" section of the game's launcher. If you have already created an account, please don't log off. If you have logged off, you can log in using you credentials. Anyway, if you have lost your credentials or you have never created an account, at the moment you will be unable to join the online features of the game.

Also, we are aware of another issue that prevents all the players to unlock new achievements on Steam.

We want to inform our PC users that we are working to solve both issues as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience.

notes.title: New patch released!
notes.notes:
Dear riders,
a new patch for Valentino Rossi The Game has just been released. We've fixed most of the issues you've reported to our [url=www.milestone.it/supporto]Customer Support[/url] and we thank you for helping us making our game better. So, here you can read what has been changed:

[h1]Changelist[/h1]

[b]Bikes:[/b]
- The number on Rossi's Yamaha M1 2016 windshield has now a more realistic look
- The front wheel on Mahindra Moto3™ has been changed to match reality

[b]Graphics, sound and animations[/b]
- Sound quality of every bike has been improved
- Animations of riders falling off the bikes have been improved

[b]AI and difficulty balancing[/b]
- AI in R1M Mode on wet tracks has been improved to become more challenging
- AI performance has been improved in Moto3™, Moto2™ and MotoGP™ on many tracks
- Riders skills on Moto3™ roster have been balanced

[b]Bugs and crashes[/b]
- Solved a bug that caused audio effects to be disabled in Rally Mode
- All the cameras now show rain effects
- Leaderboards on Misano track in R1M Mode have been fixed
- Solved a bug that caused an invisible wall to appear in Aragon track
- Solved a bug that caused the game to crash during Rally Show in Career Mode
- Solved a bug that caused the game to crash during Rally Single Stage in Online mode
- Solved a bug that caused the game to crash during semaphore countdown in Online modes
- Solved a bug that caused the game to feeeze when pressing Pause in Online modes
- Victory conditions in events 5, 6, 8 and 9 in Real Events: 2015 MotoGP™ Season DLC have been fixed
- Solved a bug that caused autopilot not to work in Enduranch Mode when manual gear was active

[b]User interface improvements[/b]
- User interface showing scores in Drift Mode has been improved
- Now the user interface doesn't show riders names if the player chooses not to show them in the options menu

notes.title: RELIVE THE HISTORY OF THE MOTOGP™
notes.notes:
After the announcement of: Flat Track with the MotorRanch of Valentino Rossi, Drift and Yamaha R1M on Misano and the trailer to Monza Rally, we come to the MotoGP™ moment. Tons of Riders, Tracks, Bikes and Liveries that will blow the gamers’ mind and will satisfy the most passionate MotoGP™ connoisseurs. For a game that claims to be the most complete MotoGP game ever made, Milestone needs to feature the history of this motorsport discipline. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24711616/1aa6057cec2ce6d81112f4646edc57a30a1cb2a4.jpg[/img]

Therefore, we have included the 500cc, 250cc and the 125cc bikes, more aggressive with with less electronics that have made the history of the past 20 years. But it wouldn’t’ be an authentic jump into the past without adding 5 of the most iconic tracks for the fans from this era. It will be possible to race and experience Assen (year 2002) or relive Phakisa Freeway (year 2004). Moreover, because the 2015 season has been one of the most exciting ever, that saw the Spanish rider Jorge Lorenzo take the title of World Champion, all the 2015 MotoGP riders have been included. All this means that will be finally possible to revisit all MotoGP™ history, getting on the most beloved bikes, challenging the nowadays champions and the ones from the past, without forgetting Valentino Rossi himself!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAtASuQBFwM

notes.title: MONZA RALLY COMES WITH AN EXCLUSIVE TRAILER
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdnext.motogpvideogame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/thumb-news-monzaTrailer.jpg[/img]

If the MotoGP™ 2016 Championship, the Flat Track, The Drift and the R1M weren’t enough to define Valentino Rossi The Game the most complete MotoGP™ game ever created, here comes the Rally. This new motorsports features 9 special stages and the amazing Monza Masters’ Show where Valentino Rossi has been protagonist and winner in 2015 edition.

Part of the VR46 World, Rally will allow to all the players to race as Valentino Rossi, one of the VR46 Academy Riders or the Custom Rider. This Game Mode will test the player with Wheels, technical corners, handbrake, pacenotes and Co-driver. 9 Special Stages in the game: Autodromo 1, Monza 1 & 2, Maxi Grand Prix, Ascari 1 & 2 and Grand Prix 1 & 2. If this is enough players can race during the Monza Masters’ Show.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KXjwcP-uM6c

The first edition of the "Rally of Monza" dates back to 1978, when the organizers decided to open the doors of the legendary circuit even to the rally cars. The Rally of Monza then comes with an image of hybrid race, although in reality the first editions approached quite similar to a real rally, with special stages run on dirt roads carved in the inland areas Autodrome. Later it became necessary to compete solely on the asphalt paths of the road circuit as well, thanks to its new and original configuration, the Rally of Monza has counted among its protagonists not only the most important Champions of World rallying, but also Formula One and MotoGp drivers! In recent years the event has gradually changed from a simple rally race in a big media event and took the current name of "Monza Rally Show". 

Follow us on Facebook http://www.facebook.com/motogpvideogame, on the official Youtube channel http://www.youtube.com/motogpvideogame, consult the official hashtag #ValentinoRossiTheGame o look at the website  www.valentinorossithegame.com.

notes.title: MISANO WORLD CIRCUIT MARCO SIMONCELLI TRACK FOR THE FIRST TIME ON SCREEN
notes.notes:
Milestone, the largest Italian racing game developer, releases a special video devoted to Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli. Into this special circuit there will be the chance to race in several game modes like: Flat Track, R1M, Rally, Drift e MotoGP™. The game will be available on June 16th for PlayStation®4, Xbox One®, the all-in-one games and entertainment system, and Windows PC/STEAM.

“Misano represents the Italian Speed Temple and the Hometown of Valentino Rossi. Since the beginning of his career Valentino Rosssi trained himself on all these disciplines like Flat Track, R1M, Drift, Rally and MotoGP to became the champion”, affirms Luca Simonotti, Lead designer Milestone."

[b]MISANO FLAT TRACK ARENA:[/b]
In Flat Track, Riders challenge on their motorbikes – called Flat Track Bike - by using a technique which consists in drifting with the foot outside to balance their weight – which looks like Motocross and Supermotard  – but at the same time is different due to the surface and the approach used. The rider’s ability and the terrain decide the result of the competition.

[b]R1M:[/b]
Participate in the special training session with the R1M Yamaha bike, a special super sportive bike manufactured by Yamaha Motor, on the Misano GP track. This Bike has been made thanks to Valentino Rossi Experience for his training.

[b]RALLY:[/b]
Rally, one of the most adrenaline motorsport disciplines, arrives in Valentino Rossi The Game thanks to 2 different Layouts for a rich experience. Wear the Rally suit and listen to your co-driver pace notes through the track choosing between: Valentino Rossi, VR46 Academy Riders, “Valentino’s Friends” or custom Rider.

[b]DRIFT:[/b]
Drift has never been so thrilling. Wear the shoes (Boots) of Valentino Rossi/VR46 Academy Riders/ Custom Rider and drift on 2 different tracks with 3 layouts each for a fueled experience.

[b]MotoGP™:[/b]
Participate in the official MotoGP™ 2016 season or the quick race and live the adrenaline on one of the most loved Italian tracks.

Valentino Rossi The Game will be available for PlayStation®4, Xbox One e Windows PC/STEAM™ from June 16th 2016.

Follow us on [url=http://www.facebook.com/motogpvideogame]Facebook[/url], on the [url=http://www.youtube.com/motogpvideogame]official Youtube channel[/url], consult the official hashtag [i]#ValentinoRossiTheGame[/i] o look at the website  www.valentinorossithegame.com.
